## Ctx.STORY\_PERIODS property

Story `active_period` values accepted by `postBusinessStory` (seconds).

**Signature:**

```typescript
static readonly STORY_PERIODS: ReadonlySet<number>;
```

## Remarks

The Bot API allows exactly 6h, 12h, 24h, and 48h; anything else is a programmer error and throws before any API call.
